description: Which name rules give an archetype its bloodline and morph target, in the generic's own shape (CjsCharacterGeneric.bloodlines, a CjsCharacterDataBloodlines), which only the library loads (CjsCharacterLibraryManager.FetchBloodline). `rule`: `headFolderLastWord`, the bloodline is the last word of the folder of the head that depends on the archetype (`head/caldari_deteis` is `deteis`). `morphTarget`: `archetypeCodeUpperShape`, the archetype's code in capitals then `Shape` (`archetypes/cdshape` is `CDShape`). Derived: no content record names an archetype's head, bloodline or morph. Ours: the client's paper doll is Python.
